title: דני לי מארחת את שורד השואה אברהם- FIGHTING TO REMEMBER

segments.title: Early Life in Holland
segments.summary: Avraham Ruth introduces himself and describes his childhood in Holland before 1940. He explains how his family believed in equality and never imagined the Holocaust could happen there.

segments.title: German Occupation Begins
segments.summary: Avraham describes the feeling of being hunted as the Germans introduced anti-Jewish laws. He recalls losing access to schools and transport, and the tragic suicide of a classmate's family.

segments.title: School and Disappearances
segments.summary: Avraham attends a segregated Jewish school, sharing a parallel class with Anne Frank. He remembers the constant fear as classmates disappeared, and the deportation of 170 children from a local orphanage.

segments.title: Hiding and Battle of Arnhem
segments.summary: The Dutch underground helps Avraham and his brothers go into hiding at separate addresses. He later witnesses the Battle of Arnhem and shares his mission to keep the memory of the Holocaust alive.
